name: JW Marriott Hotel Berlin
positioning: Large luxury city hotel beside the Tiergarten near Potsdamer Platz, with 1920s-inspired architecture and an indoor pool and wellness area
best_for: Travelers who want a base beside the Tiergarten, within walking distance of the Philharmonie and Kulturforum museums

facts.text: The hotel sits beside the Tiergarten park, which offers space for sporting activities.
Guest rooms and suites have views of Potsdamer Platz, the Tiergarten and the Embassy District.
Guests have access to a wellness area with an indoor pool, sauna, steam bath and a modern fitness center.
The architectural style is an homage to the Roaring Twenties, combining a classical ambience with state-of-the-art infrastructure.
The hotel draws on the 1920s life reform movement, represented by Bauhaus architecture at the hotel site.
Rooms and suites have marble bathrooms.
Executive Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows, and Executive Suites have a separate living room.
The German Resistance Memorial Center is less than a one-minute walk from the hotel, and the Philharmonie concert hall is a five-minute walk.
The Berlin Philharmonie and the Kulturforum museums are adjacent to the hotel.
JW Steakhouse serves locally sourced Aubrac and Uckermark beef from its dry-ager, with seating inside or on the terrace.
The concierge team handles insider tips, restaurant bookings, event tickets, limousine service and shopping recommendations.
The hotel is pet friendly, with a complimentary pet bed, serving bowls and an anti-spill placemat.

highlights.text: The hotel sits beside the Tiergarten, with rooms and suites looking out over Potsdamer Platz, the park and the Embassy District.
A wellness area with an indoor pool, sauna, steam bath and a modern fitness center.
Architecture that pays homage to the Roaring Twenties, combining a classical ambience with state-of-the-art infrastructure.
A rooftop terrace with a view over Potsdamer Platz.
The hotel's JW Garden grows fresh herbs, with lavender as its signature herb.

considerations.text: This is one of the largest event hotels in central Berlin, so expect conference and event guests.
Breakfast is available for a fee rather than included in every rate.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
